name: Gorjachie serdca
source:
What can unite people and make their hearts beat in unison?

A mutual dream of course!

Fleeing from her past and pain, the main character moves from the capital to a provincial town. But was it worth hoping for a quiet life? A childhood friend gives her a job at his coffee shop, and soon their team will be replenished with two more "hearts". Will regular work and new colleagues be able to open the heart of our heroine? Or is it not as simple as it seems?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-804]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
有什么能让人们团结，让众人的心跳同步？

当然是共同的梦想！

主人公为了逃离过去与痛苦，从首都搬到地方城市。但安静生活真的值得期待吗？青梅竹马在咖啡店给她安排了工作，很快，团队又加入两个“心”。日常工作与新同事能打开女主角的心吗？还是事情没那么简单？

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-804]Anivisual[/url]]
